crons.//: Wage-drift sweep. Xero has no payroll webhook, so a pay rise entered there is invisible until something looks. Monday 6am UTC ~= Monday afternoon AU, before the week's timesheets matter. Weekly because a wage change is a rare event and the flag is advisory — a rate that moved on Tuesday being noticed on the following Monday is fine, where a nightly job would spend quota to say 'nothing' six extra times.
